name: Streetwear Drop Poster
description: Single high-impact 9:16 key-art poster built as a poster-as-landing-page — one image that reads as a full product drop page. A fixed vertical architecture stacks four parametric slots: a tracked intro line, a MASSIVE chunky slab-serif wordmark with a 90s-cereal-box 3D bevel, a cinematic chest-up hero portrait wearing the brand's own scribbled blob mascot, a scattered DIY sticker-collage layer (vinyl stars with tape corners + pixel labels), and a bottom copy block (headline + 4 italic serif body lines + CTA pill + tracked footer strip). Y2K skate-surf streetwear register: film grain, slight vignette, CRT warmth, single saturated accent locked against a full-bleed gradient. Crisp baked typography is the point, so gpt-5.4-image-2 is the default.
referenceNotes: No reference required — the poster is generated from text alone. Attach a brand logo / product still only if a specific real product must appear.

slots.description: Fictional / real streetwear brand name shown in the footer strip + body copy.
The short punchy shout-word for the giant slab-serif wordmark (e.g. BOOM / DANG / YIKES). 3-5 letters reads best.
The single saturated accent locked across wordmark, stickers, headline, CTA (e.g. marigold #F4C542, mint #7BE3B5, hot-pink #FF4FA3).
Full-bleed background gradient endpoints (e.g. 'royal-blue #2E5BAC to deep-navy #1A2D4F').
Chest-up portrait subject: person, wardrobe, prop held at mouth level, expression.
The ORIGINAL hand-scrawled blob mascot on the hero's chest (NOT any existing brand) + the lowercase brand word on it.
Small tracked uppercase intro line above the wordmark (e.g. 'BECAUSE WE'RE YOUNG & LOUD').
4 lines of small italic serif body copy describing the brand + the drop.

doNotCopyLiterally: The three source brands (LOUD KIDS CLUB / DAYGLO DELI / STATIC YOUTH) are fictional placeholders. Reuse the ARCHITECTURE (wordmark → hero → sticker collage → copy block) + the Y2K register, not the names. Always specify an ORIGINAL blob glyph, never an existing logo.
stackSummary: openai/gpt-5.4-image-2 default — crisp baked typography (wordmark, body lines, footer strip) is the whole deliverable, and gpt-image holds small rendered text where gemini smears it. Generate the 9:16 directly; if the model returns 1024-square, post-crop/extend to 9:16. ~$0.20/image; budget ~$0.6 for one poster + 2-3 wordmark/palette re-rolls. No video/VO/music.
